weekendTasks.text: Research and choose a doula or birth partner if you want one
Tour the hospital labour ward — know the check-in process, parking, and ward layout
Start a hospital bag checklist — don't pack yet, just list

dailyHabits.text: Practise diaphragmatic breathing 5 min — foundation for labour breathing
Pelvic floor exercises (Kegel) — 3 sets of 10 slow holds
Walk 20–30 min — keeps baby in optimal position

weekendTasks.text: Attend a birth preparation class or watch a recommended birth video series
Research pain management options: epidural, gas & air, water birth, TENS
Discuss birth preferences with your partner — know each other's non-negotiables

dailyHabits.text: Practise slow breathing: inhale 4 counts, exhale 8 counts — 10 rounds
Pelvic floor exercises (Kegel) — 3 sets
Perineal massage — 5 min with coconut or almond oil

weekendTasks.text: Write your birth plan (1 page): preferences for labour, pain relief, third stage, skin-to-skin
Review birth plan with your OB or midwife — get their sign-off
Prepare a contact list: hospital number, OB/midwife, doula, back-up support person

dailyHabits.text: Practise breathing through a 60-second simulated contraction — partner times you
Perineal massage — 5 min
Left lateral lying for 30 min during rest — optimal for blood flow to baby

weekendTasks.text: Start eating 6 Medjool dates daily — RCT evidence shows shorter labour & less induction need
Make or buy colostrum collection syringes (if advised by midwife)
Attend breastfeeding class or watch a lactation consultant video series

dailyHabits.text: Eat 6 dates — morning is fine, with breakfast
Raspberry leaf tea 1 cup (check with OB first — tones uterus)
Perineal massage — 5 min

weekendTasks.text: Pack your hospital bag: mum bag + baby bag + partner bag
Install car seat and practise buckling (hospital won't discharge without one)
Prepare freezer meals: 10–15 portions for the first 2 weeks postpartum

dailyHabits.text: 6 dates daily
Practice labour position changes: all-fours, supported squat, side-lying
Perineal massage — 5 min

weekendTasks.text: Set up the nursery or baby sleeping area — bassinet, linen, nightlight
Confirm confinement lady or postpartum support — lock in dates and expectations
Do a 'hospital run drill': time the drive, test the route at different hours

dailyHabits.text: 6 dates daily
10-minute hypnobirthing or guided relaxation audio
Perineal massage — 5 min

weekendTasks.text: Write a letter to yourself about your hopes and fears for labour — don't edit, just write
Do a full body check of hospital bag — nothing missing?
Deep clean and organise home — your nest instinct is right, act on it

dailyHabits.text: 6 dates daily
10-min guided relaxation or visualisation of a calm, positive birth
Gentle prenatal yoga — hip openers and squats

weekendTasks.text: Review early labour signs: mucus plug, Braxton Hicks vs real contractions, waters breaking
Make sure phone is backed up, charged nightly, and birth partner has all contacts
Cook or freeze your last batch of meals if not done yet

dailyHabits.text: 6 dates daily
Raspberry leaf tea 1–2 cups
10-min relaxation — visualise meeting your baby

weekendTasks.text: Confirm induction/OB appointment if going past 40 weeks
Rest. Seriously — sleep, rest, sleep some more
Do something purely for yourself: a massage, a movie, a long bath

dailyHabits.text: 6 dates daily
Slow walks — baby's head position benefits from upright movement
Tell yourself: my body knows what to do 🌿
